claim: Open source search engine position tracking and keyword research app for Google
Unlimited domains and keywords; email notifications daily, weekly or monthly; built-in API
Uses third-party scrapers such as ScrapingAnt, ScrapingRobot, SearchApi, SerpApi, HasData, or your own proxy IPs
Keyword research needs integrating a Google Ads test account
Search Console integration shows visits, impressions and more per keyword
PWA mobile app; Next.js for frontend and backend; SQLite database
README table marks scrapingant.com, scrapingrobot.com and spaceserp.com as no longer working
Docker image exists on Docker Hub
Setup steps: deploy, log in, add domain, set scraping API or proxy, add keywords, optional SMTP
Development pace is shown by the live last-commit date in the table; the text gives no date
SerpApi and HasData are listed working scraping providers in the README provider table
